lines.n1: It’s Mela day in Apnapur! It starts in the evening. There will be lights, sweets and a big giant wheel. The Panchayat has ₹6,00,000 to buy things for setting up shops in the Mela. All items need to be bought before the sun goes down.
lines.g1: Wait… 42,538 plus 23,184… carry one… Let me write it all down!
lines.n2: Guddu Bhaiya will take forever if he keeps adding like this. The sun will set soon.
lines.r1: Easy! The total is ten crore!
lines.p1: Aaru, that is a wild guess. Let’s make a smart guess.
lines.p2: First, we change each price to a round number. Round numbers are easy to add. A smart guess like this is called an estimate.
lines.p3: Come! Let’s go to the bazaar.
lines.r2: All the prices are round numbers now! Yayy!
lines.p4: Well done! The shopkeepers sent their bills to the Panchayat office. Let’s check them.
lines.g2: All seven bills done? So fast? I am still on page two!
lines.p5: Bhaiya… You find out the exact amount. By that time, we will get the items for the mela shops. The shopkeepers are waiting at the Mela Ground. Let’s go and pay them.
lines.n3: The sun goes down. The Mela lights are finally on! The giant wheel starts to turn. We bought everything, and there is still money left.
lines.p6: We said about ₹84,000. That is nearly the same!
lines.n4: The Sarpanch gives you a gold badge.
lines.x1: You are Apnapur’s Smart Guess Star!
lines.L1_howto_1: Welcome to the bazaar! Every item has a price tag. The prices are big and messy.
lines.L1_howto_2: Tap the number that the price is closest to.
lines.L1_howto_3: Every right answer lights up a marigold. Look at the sun too. Let’s finish before sunset!
lines.L1_teach_1: Keep it simple, beta. Change the price to the nearest thousand.
lines.L1_teach_2: Look at this price: ₹34,872. It is between 34,000 and 35,000. Which one is closer?
lines.L1_teach_3: Look at the hundreds digit. It is 8. 8 is 5 or more, so we go up.
lines.L1_teach_ok: Yes! ₹34,872 is about ₹35,000. Now you try!
lines.L1_teach_oops: Oops! Try again. The hundreds digit is 8. 8 is 5 or more.
lines.L1_teach_hint: Hint: 5 or more means go up. Go up to 35,000.
lines.L1_oops: Oops! Try again. Look where the red arrow is on the line.
lines.L1_q1: The diyas cost ₹12,346. Is it closer to 12,000 or 13,000? Tap the answer.
lines.L1_q1_hint: Hint: Look at the hundreds digit. It is 3. 3 is less than 5, so we stay down.
lines.L1_q1_idle: Look at the red arrow. Is it nearer 12,000 or 13,000?
lines.L1_q2: The balloons cost ₹18,729. Is it closer to 18,000 or 19,000? Tap the answer.
lines.L1_q2_hint: Hint: Look at the hundreds digit. It is 7. 7 is 5 or more, so we go up.
lines.L1_q2_idle: Look at the red arrow. Is it nearer 18,000 or 19,000?
lines.L1_q3: The flags cost ₹25,481. Is it closer to 25,000 or 26,000? Tap the answer.
lines.L1_q3_hint: Hint: Look at the hundreds digit. It is 4. 4 is less than 5, so we stay down.
lines.L1_q3_idle: Look at the red arrow. Is it nearer 25,000 or 26,000?
lines.L1_q4: The rangoli colours cost ₹36,652. Is it closer to 36,000 or 37,000? Tap the answer.
lines.L1_q4_hint: Hint: Look at the hundreds digit. It is 6. 6 is 5 or more, so we go up.
lines.L1_q4_idle: Look at the red arrow. Is it nearer 36,000 or 37,000?
lines.L1_q5: The chairs cost ₹47,508. Is it closer to 47,000 or 48,000? Tap the answer.
lines.L1_q5_hint: Hint: Look at the hundreds digit. It is 5. 5 is 5 or more, so we go up.
lines.L1_q5_idle: Look at the red arrow. Is it nearer 47,000 or 48,000?
lines.L1_q6: The carpets cost ₹1,24,317. Is it closer to 1,24,000 or 1,25,000? Tap the answer.
lines.L1_q6_hint: Hint: Look at the hundreds digit. It is 3. 3 is less than 5, so we stay down.
lines.L1_q6_idle: Look at the red arrow. Is it nearer 1,24,000 or 1,25,000?
lines.L1_q7: The giant wheel costs ₹2,38,864. Is it closer to 2,38,000 or 2,39,000? Tap the answer.
lines.L1_q7_hint: Hint: Look at the hundreds digit. It is 8. 8 is 5 or more, so we go up.
lines.L1_q7_idle: Look at the red arrow. Is it nearer 2,38,000 or 2,39,000?
lines.L1_done_1: All the prices are round numbers now! Yayy!
lines.L1_done_2: Well done! The shopkeepers sent their bills to the Panchayat office. Let’s check them.
lines.L2_howto_1: Look! Seven bills on Guddu Bhaiya's desk. Each bill has two prices.
lines.L2_howto_2: You do not need to add the numbers as they are. Make each price a round number in your head. Then add the round numbers.
lines.L2_howto_3: Choose the answer closest to the total.
lines.L2_teach_1: 21,648 plus 43,315… I need my big notebook…
lines.L2_teach_4: Now add the round numbers. 22,000 plus 43,000 is 65,000. So the bill is about ₹65,000. Tap ₹65,000.
lines.L2_teach_ok: Yes! The bill is about ₹65,000. Easy! Now you try.
lines.L2_teach_oops: Oops! Try again. 22,000 plus 43,000. Count the thousands: 22 and 43.
lines.L2_teach_hint: Hint: 22 thousand plus 43 thousand is 65 thousand.
lines.L2_oops: Oops! Try again. First, make each price a round number in your head.
lines.L2_idle: Think of the round numbers. Then add them.
lines.L2_q1: Here is bill 1. Flowers ₹42,538 and garlands ₹23,184. What will be the total? Choose the closest number.
lines.L2_q1_ok: Yes! 43,000 plus 23,000 is 66,000. The bill is about ₹66,000. Look, Guddu Bhaiya is still on page one!
lines.L2_q1_hint: Hint: ₹42,538 is about 43,000. ₹23,184 is about 23,000. Now add them.
lines.L2_q2: Here is bill 2. Sweets ₹36,415 and tea ₹12,863. What will be the total? Choose the closest number.
lines.L2_q2_ok: Yes! 36,000 plus 13,000 is 49,000. The bill is about ₹49,000.
lines.L2_q2_hint: Hint: ₹36,415 is about 36,000. ₹12,863 is about 13,000. Now add them.
lines.L2_q3: Here is bill 3. Tent ₹1,24,317 and stage ₹31,642. What will be the total? Choose the closest number.
lines.L2_q3_ok: Yes! 1,24,000 plus 32,000 is 1,56,000. The bill is about ₹1,56,000.
lines.L2_q3_hint: Hint: ₹1,24,317 is about 1,24,000. ₹31,642 is about 32,000. Now add them.
lines.L2_q4: Here is bill 4. Lights ₹54,276 and wires ₹18,946. What will be the total? Choose the closest number.
lines.L2_q4_ok: Yes! 54,000 plus 19,000 is 73,000. The bill is about ₹73,000.
lines.L2_q4_hint: Hint: ₹54,276 is about 54,000. ₹18,946 is about 19,000. Now add them.
lines.L2_q5: Here is bill 5. Speaker ₹47,892 and mic ₹26,354. What will be the total? Choose the closest number.
lines.L2_q5_ok: Yes! 48,000 plus 26,000 is 74,000. The bill is about ₹74,000.
lines.L2_q5_hint: Hint: ₹47,892 is about 48,000. ₹26,354 is about 26,000. Now add them.
lines.L2_q6: Here is bill 6. Snacks ₹28,163 and plates ₹15,214. What will be the total? Choose the closest number.
lines.L2_q6_ok: Yes! 28,000 plus 15,000 is 43,000. The bill is about ₹43,000.
lines.L2_q6_hint: Hint: ₹28,163 is about 28,000. ₹15,214 is about 15,000. Now add them.
lines.L2_q7: Here is bill 7. Food ₹33,745 and water ₹21,286. What will be the total? Choose the closest number.
lines.L2_q7_ok: Yes! 34,000 plus 21,000 is 55,000. The bill is about ₹55,000.
lines.L2_q7_hint: Hint: ₹33,745 is about 34,000. ₹21,286 is about 21,000. Now add them.
lines.L3_howto_1: Here is the Mela money: ₹6,00,000. Seven shopkeepers will come for their money.
lines.L3_howto_2: Each time we pay, the money gets less. Make the bill a round number in your head. Then take it away.
lines.L3_howto_3: Choose about how much money is left.
lines.L3_teach_1: Let’s try one. For example, we have ₹2,00,000. The bill is ₹38,760.
lines.L3_teach_2: First, round off the bill. ₹38,760 is about 39,000.
lines.L3_teach_guddu: Let me try... It’s 2,00,000 minus 38,760... borrow one... um...
lines.L3_teach_3: Now take it away. 2,00,000 minus 39,000 is 1,61,000. Tap ₹1,61,000.
lines.L3_teach_exact: Umm... it’s 1,61,240 to be exact. But your number is so close. Good job!
lines.L3_teach_baba: Very good. Now the real money: ₹6,00,000. Let’s pay!
lines.L3_teach_oops: Oops! Try again. We are paying, so the money gets less.
lines.L3_teach_hint: Hint: 200 thousand take away 39 thousand is 161 thousand.
lines.L3_teach_idle: Take the round number away from the money.
lines.L3_oops: Oops! Try again. We are paying, so the money gets less.
lines.L3_idle: Round the bill first. Then take it away from the money.
lines.L3_q1: The flower seller wants ₹65,722. We have ₹6,00,000. About how much money is left?
lines.L3_q1_hint: Hint: ₹65,722 is about 66,000. Now take 66,000 away from 6,00,000.
lines.L3_q2: The sweet shop wants ₹49,278. We have about ₹5,34,000. About how much money is left?
lines.L3_q2_hint: Hint: ₹49,278 is about 49,000. Now take 49,000 away from 5,34,000.
lines.L3_q3: The tent house wants ₹1,55,959. We have about ₹4,85,000. About how much money is left?
lines.L3_q3_hint: Hint: ₹1,55,959 is about 1,56,000. Now take 1,56,000 away from 4,85,000.
lines.L3_q4: The light shop wants ₹73,222. We have about ₹3,29,000. About how much money is left?
lines.L3_q4_hint: Hint: ₹73,222 is about 73,000. Now take 73,000 away from 3,29,000.
lines.L3_q5: The sound shop wants ₹74,246. We have about ₹2,56,000. About how much money is left?
lines.L3_q5_hint: Hint: ₹74,246 is about 74,000. Now take 74,000 away from 2,56,000.
lines.L3_q6: The snack stall wants ₹43,377. We have about ₹1,82,000. About how much money is left?
lines.L3_q6_hint: Hint: ₹43,377 is about 43,000. Now take 43,000 away from 1,82,000.
lines.L3_q7: The food stall wants ₹55,031. We have about ₹1,39,000. About how much money is left?
lines.L3_q7_ok: Yes! About ₹84,000 is left. We paid everyone!
lines.L3_q7_hint: Hint: ₹55,031 is about 55,000. Now take 55,000 away from 1,39,000.
